title: Prismatic CronRunReceipt v1
description: Schema for immutable CronRunReceipt v1 contracts. Defines data shape, bounds, terminal outcomes, and field constraints. execution_id is opaque in v1; GRO-4345 owns trigger-identity and uniqueness-key semantics.

cron_id.description: Identifier for the target cron job definition.

execution_id.description: Opaque execution identity in v1. GRO-4345 owns trigger-identity and uniqueness-key semantics.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome of the cron execution attempt.

runner_id.description: Identity of the runner process or node executing the task.

runner_release_digest.description: Exact SHA-256 digest of the runner release artifact (64 lowercase hex chars).

started_at.description: Timezone-aware RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when execution started.

finished_at.description: Timezone-aware RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when execution finished.

error_classification.description: Bounded error classification if failed/errored, or null.

evidence_digest.description: Bounded SHA-256 digest of evidence artifact (64 lowercase hex chars), or null.

signing_key_id.description: Identity of the key used to sign the receipt.

signature.description: Signature value over the receipt contract payload.
